ns2:course.label: Topics in Hist of Instrum Mus
ns2:course.description: Intensive study of a period or school of instrumental composition, or of a particular genre of instrumental music. Includes wide reading in the social and intellectual climate of the period concerned; structural and stylistic analysis; and work with primary sources, whenever available. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: MUS 528, graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
